23e74158fa28.content: Trade items are manufacturer-specific branded health products that are identifiable and unique to a particular brand or manufacturer. Handbook wording, quoted (Ch 2, page 28). A candidate: not adopted. Owner ruling 2026-10-31: Trade Item is the WHO concept, with this narrow sense; the GS1 trade item is a separate external concept and the WHO term's broadMatch (every WHO Trade Item is a GS1 trade item, not the reverse: GS1's also covers services). The handbook's glossary (page 9) prints the GS1 wording, 'Products or services that are priced, ordered or invoiced at any point in the supply chain', citing GS1 (its reference 13); that sentence is GS1's definition, recorded here as a note, not as this concept's. litlfred/smart-ra#142 item 1.
